turns.q: Hi! I'm looking for a gift for someone and I'm not sure what to pick, can you help?
turns.replyTail:
Hi Adam,

Thanks for reaching out to MESHKI.

When you are not sure what to pick, a MESHKI Gift Card is a wonderful and flexible choice ✨. It allows your recipient to select their favourite pieces from our collection.

Our digital gift cards are available in values of £25, £50, and £100, and they are delivered electronically via email. They are valid for 3 years from the date of purchase with no additional processing fees.

Hope you have a great day! Let me know if you need anything else.

turns.q: My budget is moderate, what would make a good gift in that range?
turns.replyTail: Adam, for a moderate budget, our £50 MESHKI Gift Card makes a fantastic choice. It sits right in the middle of our denominations and gives your recipient wonderful flexibility to pick out an item they will genuinely use and enjoy.

turns.q: Between your top two gift ideas, which feels more special?
turns.replyTail: Adam, both options share the same wonderful flexibility, but opting for the £50 MESHKI Gift Card feels especially balanced for a moderate budget. It provides enough value for them to pick out a staple piece they will love and use often, while keeping the gesture personal and thoughtful.

turns.q: Is there a gift set or bundle that looks nicer than a single item?
turns.replyTail: Adam, while we do not offer pre-packaged gift boxes, you can easily create a stunning, coordinated gift set by pairing matching separates, such as a blazer and shorts from our suiting collections like the Agatha or Solenne lines. These matching pieces look polished and feel exceptionally well put together for someone who appreciates quality. Alternatively, a MESHKI Gift Card lets them choose their own favourite pairings.

turns.q: Can it arrive gift-ready, and how fast can it ship?
turns.replyTail:
Adam, our MESHKI Gift Cards are delivered electronically via email, and you can choose from a range of lovely graphic designs to make the digital presentation feel special and ready to send. Because they are digital, they arrive almost instantly.

If you decide on physical clothing items instead, please note that all orders are shipped from our warehouse in Australia, so customers in the UK should expect international shipping timelines.
